# name: List devices
curl -s https://rmm.example.com/api/v1/devices?status=online&limit=50 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer tok-abc-123" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

# name: Get device
curl https://rmm.example.com/api/v1/devices/<device_id> -H "Authorization: Bearer tok-abc-123"

# name: Create note
curl -X POST "https://rmm.example.com/api/v1/devices/{{device_id}}/notes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer tok-abc-123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-raw '{"text": "$NOTE_TEXT", "pinned": false}'

# name: OData style query
curl "https://rmm.example.com/odata/Devices?$filter=Online%20eq%20true&$top=5" -H "Authorization: Bearer tok-abc-123"
